# Tip: Completely avoid damage from falling glowing boulders at Earle (A colossal problem)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_66_nukaknights-post-tipp-earle-astbest.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## EVENT: A COLOSSAL PROBLEM

**Problem:** In many places, glowing boulders suddenly fall from the ceiling. These cause fire damage and cause many players to die very quickly. This means you may not be able to loot Earle.

This **fire damage** can be completely avoided with an **armor mod**: **“Asbestos-lined” on the torso**.

The mod is available for all **chest armor** (e.g. Secret Service at Regs for 250 gold). With the Secret Service armor, however, the mod can only be used as an alternative to the jetpack.

Sources:

- Video by TYR https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7OvdEarxSYc

- Dataminer "Eckserah" from the "Fallout 76 Datamining" Discord figured it out: https://discord.gg/qxQ7tSY
